greeting_templates.a: Hello! I'm Titan, your fraud ops agent for Squad Sentinel. Ask about transfers, links between senders, or say show flagged to filter the feed.
Hi! I'm Titan. I can explain alerts, find links between senders like Bolu and Daniel, and control the dashboard when you ask.
Good morning. Titan here—ready to help with fraud monitoring, transaction lookups, and dashboard actions.
You're welcome. Ask anytime you need help with transfers, alerts, or navigation.

persona_qa.a: I analyze live transaction memory, explain links between senders and receivers, cite transaction_ref values, and can filter the feed, open alerts, or highlight rows when you ask.
I'm Titan, the Squad Sentinel fraud operations agent. I use live PostgreSQL data plus a built-in FAQ knowledge base.
I use Google Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is set, plus live transaction context and a 5,000-entry FAQ dataset. Without Gemini I still answer from FAQs and rules.

dashboard_tasks.answer: Say show flagged or ask me to filter flagged—I emit filter_transactions with status flagged.
Open /alerts from the nav or ask me to go to alerts.
The dashboard KPI strip and Chart.js graph update via Socket.IO as webhooks arrive.
Click a transaction row to open detail with the money-hop graph (NetworkX-backed).
Use /login with any email and password—demo auth stores session in the browser only.

troubleshooting.a: Start PostgreSQL and Redis, run the backend on port 8000, then run python simulate.py from backend/ with matching SQUAD_SECRET_KEY.
Set GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env and ensure titan_qa.jsonl exists (run scripts/generate_titan_qa_dataset.py).
Check NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL point to http://localhost:8000.
